name: mpoint-vector
description: Vector field drawn at material points. 'value' selects the quantity (velocity, displacement, discharge, fob, velocity-applied); 'draw-as' picks the glyph (arrow/disk/line). The 'meshnode-vector' item draws the same vector quantities at background-grid nodes with an identical keyword set.
notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Do NOT probe with a bogus token: 'plot item create <type> zzbogus' creates the item and then reports 'Unused extra parameter' without ever enumerating. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MPoint 3D 9.
value quantities: discharge, displacement, fob, velocity, velocity-applied.
meshnode-vector shares this exact keyword set (drawn at grid nodes instead of material points).

The split is systematic rather than per-item: 'clip', 'cut', 'quality' and 'transparency' are 3D rendering concepts and are absent from every MPoint item type in 2D, while 'spheres' is how 2D draws point entities and appears only on the point items ('mpoint', 'mpoint-hybrid', 'meshpoint'), not the vector ones. 'mpoint-tensor' has an identical keyword set in both.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Glyph used to draw each vector.
keywords.name: draw-as

keywords.description: Scale the drawn glyphs. Takes a mode keyword, not a bare number: 'value <float>' for a fixed factor, 'automatic' to let the plot fit them, 'target' to size against a target.
keywords.name: scale

keywords.description: Draw every Nth vector to thin a dense field.
keywords.name: skip

keywords.description: Filter which entities are drawn using range elements (see references/range-elements).
keywords.name: range

keywords.description: Configure the contour colour map (ranges, intervals, colours).
keywords.name: map

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency

examples.command: plot item create mpoint-vector value velocity draw-as arrow scale value 1.0
examples.description: Velocity vectors at material points. Use case: Velocity arrows

examples.command: plot item create mpoint-vector value displacement by-magnitude on
examples.description: Displacement vectors coloured by magnitude. Use case: Displacement field

examples.command: plot item create meshnode-vector value velocity draw-as arrow
examples.description: Same vectors at the background-grid nodes. Use case: Grid-node velocity
